The '''Imperial Embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], which was located in the city of [[Mondder]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]].

==History==
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the Imperial Embassy held a party hosted by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Blains Vorlin]]. [[Jahan Cross]] and [[IN-GA 44]] attended the party.
